benchmark_name: ObjectMemory Physical Workbench Benchmark (7 Sequences, 35 Visits)
provenance: Physical smartphone photographs cropped and saved as RGBA PNG without EXIF metadata. Evaluated as a real-world pilot validation sequence, not a formal laboratory metrology benchmark.

track_a_natural_image_detection.description: Evaluates object detection on real workbench photographs using letterbox preprocessing.

track_b_oracle_temporal_evaluation.description: Evaluates multi-visit temporal reasoning and entity association with idealized ground-truth bounding boxes.

entity_level_evaluation.description: Evaluates per-entity epistemic state correctness across all visits using Kuhn-Munkres matching.

known_limitations_and_provenance_notes: Track A requires genuine photographic imagery to compute valid precision, recall, and mAP.
Track B evaluates multi-visit state transitions with oracle bounding boxes to establish algorithmic upper bounds.
Track C evaluates actual detector predictions through the complete pipeline without substituting ground-truth boxes.
Planar homography registration assumes approximately coplanar workbench surface; significant 3D camera parallax will cause perspective distortion.
The 35-pixel movement threshold is defined in nominal 1920x1080 pixel coordinates.
